## Models (P-40)
- Implementer (model, effort):
- Reviewer (model, effort; not the implementer's model and context):

## Per-commit checklist
- [ ] Prose is minimal: no history, no ids, docstrings say what and how (P-31).
- [ ] No duplicated logic; surfaces are thin over shared engines (P-32).
- [ ] No second function for an existing behaviour, and no copied variant. Variants are
  parameters, strategies or backends, with no caller-specific branches (P-37).
- [ ] The scale ladder passes for touched modules; per-item cost is flat (P-33).
- [ ] New boundaries have bad-input, fault and property tests; there is no special-casing (P-34).
- [ ] No identifiers; tests are scoped and serial (P-28, P-29).
- [ ] Every new task, backend or profile is declared, so contract tests cover it (P-30).
- [ ] The PR records the implementer and reviewer models, and they differ (P-40).
- [ ] The ledger mark is current for any 1.x area touched (P-39).

## Brittleness (P-34)
The change does not depend on an accident. Tick what holds; explain what does not.
- [ ] Timing: no sleep, retry or timeout added to hide a race.
- [ ] Ordering: nothing relies on dict, set, directory or completion order.
- [ ] One dataset, recording, subject, model id or host: no branch on any of them.
- [ ] One model's quirk or output: no test asserts a model's current output or a measured number outside `benchmarks/`.
- [ ] Magic numbers: no threshold literal tuned to make one case pass; limits are data with a derivation (P-17).
- [ ] String matches on output: none.
- [ ] Unknown failures are typed and propagate; no try/except turns one into a default value.
- [ ] Every new boundary is exercised with bad input.

## Gates
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes.
- [ ] `lint-imports` passes.
- [ ] Logic tier and `-m contract` pass, run serially and scoped to the packages touched.
- [ ] A new dependency has its license in `scripts/data/license_policy.yaml` (P-23).
